name: XPEL
verdict: Nasdaq-listed; its holders above 5% are BlackRock (14.6%), Wasatch Advisors (13.8%), Vanguard (5.3%), Alta Fox (5.2%) and director Richard K. Crumly (5.1%, an individual). Nothing found.
note: Rating note: joined BMW M Motorsport as a partner in 2026 per BMW's press release; no state stake and no human-rights finding against XPEL located.
